description: Legacy categorized FHIR response. Kept compatible for existing prototypes. For normalized platform-shaped data, use get_demo_health_record. Fictional patients only; pick one with scenario.

categories.description: Optional subset of normalized record categories.

scenario.description: Optional scenario id from list_demo_scenarios. Omitted means baseline-adult. Behavior scenarios (rate-limited, consent-revoked, consent-partial, source-unavailable) answer with the same scripted error or partial result as the REST demo.
